title: HAL test: Add assertion or comment for NULL identity_get call
description: Line 109 of lichen/tests/hal/src/main.c calls lichen_hal_identity_get(NULL) without any assertion or comment explaining the intent. Other HAL NULL-handling tests assert -EINVAL, but this void function silently returns. Either document the intent with a comment or consider removing the call since the API is marked _Nonnull.
close_reason: Already fixed: The lichen_hal_identity_get(NULL) call was removed from line 109 of lichen/tests/hal/src/main.c. The test function now ends without the undocumented NULL call.
